issue.title: Fix Qute namespace extensions with no parameters

body: @wjglerum The https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/15238 should fix the problem. The other issue is caused by the fact that your example defines a different package for `Quark`, i.e. there is no `org.acme.qute.Quark`.

Hi @mkouba that's great to hear, thanks for your work!

Aah I see, I indeed changed the package name, that's my bad 😉
@gsmet / @mkouba  could we maybe add this fix to the `1.12.1.Final` milestone? As this blocks us from upgrading our project to quarkus 1.12 at the moment.
